name: dsh-swarm-scheduler-beta

one_liner.zh: 把 DSH 编码工作拆成任务池并由多个会话并行领取
one_liner.en: Coordinate parallel DSH coding sessions through a file-backed task pool

local: 需要设置 tasksRoot 为任务池根目录；任务以 JSON 文件保存在该目录下的 .dsh-tasks。

config_items.name: tasksRoot
config_items.description: 任务池根目录；为空时插件激活会报错。

config_items.name: auto_reap
config_items.description: 开启空闲事件触发的自动回收。

config_items.name: max_workers
config_items.description: 同时领取及运行的任务上限。

config_items.name: quality_gate_command
config_items.description: 完成任务时可选执行的质量门禁命令。

config_items.name: worker_profiles
config_items.description: 按 worker 配置等级、能力、上下文窗口和成本率。

readme_mismatch: README describes a client panel and 11 tools in its architecture section, while src/client/index.ts intentionally registers no UI and src/tools-file.ts currently registers 11 tools (the README elsewhere references the eleven; implementation has 11). No mismatch recorded for tool count.

README installation text describes adding the Agent Teams profile bundle, while current src/index.ts injects tools, fs, and systemPrompt only; task scheduling is implemented through the file pool. The documentation's bundle dependency is not reflected in the current entry implementation.
